name: sanjin
about: sanjin (三陣, the third wave), the third campaign of Ten-Go (7 Nov 2026): the skeleton of the third curve of Fig. 0NNbp, gamma_sigma = 75393/994361 g = 0.7582 gamma_a (gamma_a = 0.1 g; g2(P->0) = 0.933, the k = 2 of the eleven of Sec. 26), on 0.15-12.51 g as nijin; first a pilot that sets the orders, run beside nijin at the level high (Fabrice, 7 Nov: 'prepare the pilot now'), then the grid 0.15 + 0.004 j g in van der Corput order (added by --zoen once the pilot has spoken and nijin has nothing free)

parts.about: the pilot: the 16 pumps of nijin's (0.15 + 0.004 j g) at orders 150 with weights, 200, 250, 300 and 400, all at 80 digits, and 300 at 160 digits at 5.502, 6.002 and 11.002 g: up to what pump 150/200 (B) agrees with 300/400 (E) at this gamma_sigma, whether 250/300 (D) does above, and whether 80 digits hold; the orders of the grid follow from it (code/nijin_pilot.py --sakusen sanjin)
